text:
alex: PTAL — addressed the comments from yesterday; split the scheduler fix into its own commit, added smoke steps and recorded a ~1min video link in the PR. Re-requesting review, would like to get this into today's canary. Key change: fixed flaky job-runner by adding exponential backoff and a small env override `SCHEDULER_RETRY=3`. Ping @mira @sam for one more approver. :eyes:

mira: quick q — did you benchmark with long-running jobs? are we adding noticeable latency on dispatch?

alex: short benches on staging: median dispatch +2ms, p95 unchanged. The bigger win is eliminated 50% timeout flake we saw last week. I'll paste the micro-bench numbers in the PR comment (non-blocking perf delta).

sam: LGTM from my side, saw the inline nit about a log message — non-blocking. happy to approve once you rebase and squash the small fix. :+1:

jamie: PTAL as well when you get a moment, I can take merge custody if we hit the canary window. free in ~30m.

alex: thanks — smoke steps are below (also added to the PR description):

```
# smoke test (staging)
make smoke
curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood-inference.internal/run \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"job":"short","payload":"hello"}'

kubectl -n staging logs -l app=job-runner --tail=200 | grep "job completed" || echo "no success log"
```

alex: also added a short script `tools/smoke/run_quick_smoke.sh` to record the run and collect logs. Rebase incoming in a minute. :hugging_face:

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled at 2026-03-20T18:00:00Z for team-eng. You are queued at position 2.

alex: great, thanks deploy-bot. rebased and pushed, PTAL again — pinging @sam for approve when free. :thumbsup:
